# cA2A

> Verify signed delegation chains and peer trust evidence for A2A. Start with a local grant and scope-escalation check.

cA2A adds signed delegation, peer appraisal, sealed channels, and linked provenance to A2A communication. Begin with offline grant verification against a separately trusted root. Live runtime checks and hardware assurance require additional evidence and explicit relying-party policy. Part of AgenTrust, open specifications for verifiable AI: https://agentrust-io.com.
